remarks: Welcome Home to Wilton Hills! A wonderful community nestled in highly sought after South Wilton, consisting of 18 free-standing homes, with one that stands out above the rest! This amazing 4BR 3.5 Bath home boasts over 3600+ sq. ft. & is sure to please from the moment you walk through the front door. The main level features a sun-filled family room w/ gas fireplace, formal dining room, open concept living room w/ 2nd fireplace, which flows nicely into the lovely white kitchen w/ SS appliances, gas cooktop, dishwasher, & tons of cabinet space. On this floor you will also find a beautiful powder room & all the rooms have walkouts to the massive deck overlooking the rolling, professionally landscaped yard - perfect for entertaining guests! As you make your way upstairs, you'll notice the Primary BR Suite w/ vaulted ceilings, a stunning fully remodeled spa-like bathroom, & enormous walk-in closet. There are also 2 additional bedrooms on this level, along with an alluring updated main hallway bath, & laundry room w/ new washer & dryer. Fully finished lower level w/ walkout offers another spacious bedroom, updated full bath, dedicated office w/ built-ins, & storage. This incredible home also comes fully equipped with central A/C, recessed lighting, attached 2 car garage, irrigation system, & hardwood floors throughout. Enjoy the summer months soaking up the sun or splashing around the gorgeous in ground pool. Public water & public sewer. Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity!!
